steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields for the line item.

args.goal: on the single-stage RFQ create screen, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", click Done, and stop with the saved clauses and mandatory override state visible

steps.note: Configure the delivery location and the two mandatory terms, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Invite one available QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Verify the event reached its published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet as the vendor.
Verify the first mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept the required terms through the bid flow, quote 100, and submit the vendor bid.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer sees the expected confirmation that the bidder accepted the terms.
